use_case: Computer-vision crop yield prediction from weekly drone imagery of the U-pick strawberries, used to decide how many reservation slots to open each weekend
vendor_or_model: AI yield vendor (SaaS computer-vision model, SYS-08); click-through terms
source_evidence: EV-031 (trial account and forecast history); EV-032 (click-through terms); EV-038 (accuracy review); EV-029 (drone records)
data_categories: Drone RGB and multispectral imagery (customers may appear incidentally); block boundaries; variety and planting dates; weekend picked pounds
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: U-pick customers who book slots; people in images)
human_in_the_loop: Owner checks each forecast against a count of ripe fruit in 3 sample rows before opening slots; slots capped at 80% of the forecast until a season of accuracy is shown
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (the farm's own claims to customers; vendor claims); Fla. Stat. 501.171 not triggered (images are not personal information as defined); no crop insurance or program use
status: Approved with conditions (data terms or stop by 2026-10-31)
